progress_reporting.when: After each implemented screen, before switching workspace or handoff. Propose only tested items; identify the build and limitations. Do not duplicate unchanged pending/accepted work. Human approval still required.

delivery_gate.rule:
A screen or workspace is unfinished until its working UI, F1 contextual help, English/Urdu screen handbook,
workspace guide and detailed FAQ for every supported role, bounded 100-250% keyboard zoom, frontend coverage checks,
and named human review of fresh, newly created data and supported CRUD operations are complete. Follow the workspace review
checklist (guide 17). Missing evidence stays pending; seeded-demo browsing, API tests or screenshots alone do not
establish completion. Agents propose evidence; only authenticated human review accepts progress.

compulsory.label: F1 contextual help
compulsory.what: F1 opens the correct permitted help, including from fields/dialogs, preserves unsaved work and restores focus. Visible Help also works; login/locked/kiosk help exposes only public/operator guidance.

compulsory.label: Complete role-specific FAQs
compulsory.what: Every supported role task in this workspace, including shared screens and handovers, has a detailed reviewed English/Urdu FAQ. Follow get_handbook_outline; a generic FAQ or an unreviewed role journey is unfinished.

compulsory.label: Keyboard zoom: 100-250% only
compulsory.what: Ctrl++/Ctrl+=, Ctrl+- and Ctrl+0 (Command on macOS), Settings and all enabled zoom routes share one state clamped to 100-250%. Test both bounds, reset, persistence and usable English/Urdu layouts at 250%.

compulsory.label: Human review with newly created data
compulsory.what: A named human follows guide 17 on this build: creates new synthetic records through the UI and verifies read, update/correction and permitted delete/cancel/deactivate paths, refusal paths and handovers. Read-only screens use fresh upstream records. Record IDs and evidence; pre-existing demo data alone is insufficient.

zoom.one_state: The keys, the Settings slider and any menu, wheel or pinch zoom move ONE zoom state, clamped to 100.0-250.0 %, saved as ui_scale_pct (PUT /settings/me) and restored at login (/auth/me preferences). Electron: webContents.setZoomFactor(pct / 100).

delivery_gate.workspace_done_when: Every screen of the workspace has every compulsory item above, in addition to its endpoints, events and rules: F1 contextual Help, a detailed FAQ for every role of the workspace (English and Urdu), the bounded keyboard zoom and a named human's review with newly created data (get_guide('workspace-review-checklist')), signed on the portal. Missing any one, the workspace is NOT done: report it as pending, never as complete.

acceptance_rules: Discharge desk: clear the BillingSettlement stage after POST /admissions/{admission_id}/final-bill and the payment; stages clear strictly in order (DISCHARGE_STAGE_OUT_OF_ORDER names details.blocked_on).

A Code Red admission arrives with is_billing_deferred: show it in a 'Billing to confirm' list. Once the patient is stable (and identified: merge the trauma profile first), confirm Cash or the panel with POST /admissions/{admission_id}/confirm-billing. Deferred is never free: its charges are on the running bill from the first day, and the final bill and the BillingSettlement stage answer BILLING_DEFERRED until it is confirmed.
BED_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE means someone else took the bed a moment ago — refresh the matrix and pick another.

An admission that will not happen (the family went elsewhere, the doctor decided against it) is cancelled with its reason: POST /admissions/{admission_id}/cancel, only while pending (ADMISSION_STATE_INVALID once admitted: discharge instead). A reserved bed turns Available again; refresh on admission.cancelled.
Overflow needs a reason; the primary doctor keeps rounds (they get admission.overflow_assigned).

Admission: show the Patient Photo (photo_document_id) for the identity check, or offer to take one. Patient Photo is OPTIONAL here and everywhere (never a required field, never a blocker): offer 'Take photo' (camera) or 'Choose file' (JPEG or PNG), preview, retake, and 'Skip' needing no reason. Ask first; respect a refusal (purdah, privacy) and never delay an emergency, an injured face or a patient who cannot cooperate. Upload it after the patient exists: POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents doc_type=Photo, its own Idempotency-Key, so a failed upload never repeats a registration, a payment or an admission. Show photo_document_id (patient, admission) through GET /patient-documents/{document_id}/download. Allocating, overflow and arrival never wait for it.

'Reports brought by the patient' (optional, any number): file (PDF, or a JPEG/PNG scan or photo of the paper), type (LabReport, Imaging, DischargeSummary, Prescription, ReferralLetter, Other), title (the test or report, e.g. 'CBC'), issued by (source_facility, required) and the date on it (document_date) → POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents with is_outside=true. List them labelled 'Outside: <facility>, <date>', apart from this hospital's own results: they are never shown or counted as this hospital's lab or imaging results.

Exists for the service inpatient (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id pending_admissions (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
demo_accounts: demo_accounts() lists a login per role; sandbox_call runs each case on the DEV server
